name: Cursor
description: AI-first code editor built on VS Code, with integrated AI pair programming, inline editing, and chat capabilities

version_check.note: Official Cursor update API. Use darwin-arm64 or darwin-x64 variants if universal URL fails.

download.note: Version check returns the installable ZIP URL in the same JSON (download_path=url).

notes: Cursor update API at api2.cursor.sh returns JSON {name, url}. The old cursor.com/api/download endpoint returns HTTP 500 externally. Universal ZIP is preferred; arm64/x64 endpoints also exist.
